params.name: page
params.description: The page number to be retrieved, for the list of templates. So, a combination of `page=1` and `page_size=20` returns the first 20 templates. A combination of `page=2` and `page_size=20` returns the next 20 templates.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of templates to return in the response.

params.name: total_required
params.description: Indicates whether the to show total_pages and total_items in the response.

items.docs: Searches for and lists invoices that match search criteria. If you pass multiple criteria, the response lists invoices that match all criteria.
